problem_statement: Manual chasing creates delays and inconsistency.
value_proposition: Turn repetitive operator work into a focused daily action system

offer.headline: Turn repetitive operator work into a focused daily action system

workflow.prompt_placeholder: e.g. We keep repeating manual tasks and missing follow-ups.

rules.first_step: List the workflow in three steps and automate the highest-friction step first.
next_steps: Apply kill criteria if traction stays below threshold.

default_response.first_step: Start with one user path, one measurable outcome, and one weekly review cadence.
next_steps: Avoid adding extra features before signal appears.
Capture user feedback in structured notes.
Ship one focused iteration per cycle.

metrics.target: At least 5 qualified leads from first 20 targeted users in 14 days
kill_criteria: Fewer than 2 qualified intent captures after 20 targeted visitors
Core workflow completion rate below 20% in first-session usage

adapter.name: generic-operator
adapter.description: Fallback adapter for opportunities without strong domain keyword match.

business_tests.name: generic_bottleneck_response
business_tests.input: We have too many manual repetitive tasks in operations.

proof_points: Ships one measurable workflow instead of bloated feature sets.

faq.question: Is this only for one industry?
faq.answer: No. The adapter model is designed to support multiple business opportunity types.

faq.question: Can we iterate quickly after launch?
faq.answer: Yes. Rules, modules, and tests can be updated independently without full rebuilds.

operational_checklist: Ship one focused workflow for that bottleneck.
Review conversion signal weekly and decide go/kill.
cta_support_text: Join early access to validate one focused workflow before scaling scope.
